text: One day every living thing in the English village of Midwich falls unconscious, and [a caged canary drops at the border|images|animals and birds]. Two months later every woman and girl of child-bearing age is pregnant. The children are born on the same day with platinum hair and arresting eyes, and grow into [a cold, impeccably dressed group with no conscience|threat|dangerous children]. Professor Zellaby tries to teach them while they [read minds and force villagers to kill themselves|rules|it has unnatural powers].
